message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a costume that is not well-made, which means it is classified as a festive article (Chapter 95) rather than as wearing apparel. Chapter 61 and 62 notes exclude carnival costumes: Note 1(e) to Chapter 62 and similar notes say that garments of "carnival" type that are flimsy are classified in 9505. Specifically, Chapter 95 covers "festive, carnival or other entertainment articles," and costumes of the sort are classified under 9505.90.

The HTS for costumes is 9505.90.6000 ("Festive, carnival or other entertainment articles... Other: Other"). Since 2007 the subheading is 9505.90.60 (other), and the 10-digit is 9505.90.6000.

Adult costumes made of textile that are not well-made are classified under 9505.90.6000.

{"hts_code": "9505.90.6000", "reason": "The poorly made, flimsy costume dress with loose, exposed stitching and elastic is a festive/carnival costume article of heading 9505, not wearing apparel of Chapter 61 or 62."}
